title: Multiplicity-Isolated Cores and Chromatic Symmetric Reconstruction of Trees
summary: Stanley's tree-isomorphism conjecture asks whether the chromatic symmetric function distinguishes nonisomorphic trees. We give a reconstruction criterion that permits repeated leaf-component orders. For a proper tree, collapse each leaf component to its center and record its order as a vertex weight. We prove that the chromatic symmetric function reconstructs the tree whenever every nonleaf vertex of this weighted core has a weight that occurs nowhere else in the core.
